sourceType: Official anonymous public MV chart, not a TV-specific or personalized ranking.
fixture: netease-top-mv.json is reduced to chart metadata and picture IDs. No account cookies, device identity, keys or playback URLs were sent or retained.
imageSelection: Use returned cover, upgrading HTTP to HTTPS only. Do not derive URLs from pic16v9 or append resize parameters. A pic16v9 label does not prove the original is landscape.
runtimePolicy: requireFullHdArtwork=true reuses native >=1920x1080 and 16:9 ratio tolerance 0.01 checks before display; under-resolution and square originals are skipped.
refresh: Use the existing live-feed cache policy. updateTime followed the request timestamp in this audit and is not established as the chart publication time or a daily update guarantee.
